name: ffmpeg-skill
why: The technical backbone for any talking-head edit: 42 scripted tools with a machine-readable contract — cut/join/silence removal, reframe to 9:16, word-timed and karaoke captions, multicam + external-mic sync, loudness to platform targets, contact sheets for visual checks, and platform compliance checks. Pure Python 3.10+ standard library, no cloud, no API keys, no ASR dependency, so it is fully usable in this sandbox.
caveats: It executes an edit; it does not decide one. Editorial choices stay with maalsadiqeen-reel or the agent.
Transcription is out of scope: captions need a timed text file or --transcribe with a local engine.
docs/, tests/, evals/, demos/ and the repo's own .claude dev skills were dropped from the vendored copy to keep the repo light; nothing the skill reads at runtime was removed.
